segments.text: Welcome to the PPTI Research Brief for October 2026.
This edition covers the rolling twenty-four-month period ending
31 October 2026.
The portfolio contains 570 distinct Scopus-indexed publications
from 64 PPTI contributors, appearing across 315 journals.
Open-access articles account for 43.5 percent of the portfolio.
In the latest completed month, publication output held steady
from 11 to 11 articles.
Compared with the preceding monthly edition, the rolling portfolio
recorded an increase of 11 publications and an increase of
104 citations.
Three journals represented in the latest completed month are
ACS Omega, Clean Technologies and Environmental Policy, and Journal
of Environmental Chemical Engineering.
Three recurring themes represented that month are Chitosan, Shelf
Life, and Digestibility.
They appear in 9, 8, and 6 rolling-window publications, respectively.
These signals show both established strength and activity beyond
the highest-volume outlets and themes.
Read the full PPTI publication trends report for the complete
evidence.
